questions.q: What does it mean to be perfect, as Abram was commanded at ninety and nine?
choices: To walk in His statutes and keep His commandments
questions.explain: A perfect heart walks in His statutes and keeps His commandments (1 Kings 8:61).

questions.q: With whom is the covenant established, according to Genesis 17:7?
choices: Everyone who believes, whatever their nation
Abraham and his literal seed after him
questions.explain: Seed is literal offspring, not a spiritual metaphor. Israel is the seed of Abraham (Isaiah 41:8).

questions.q: What is the token of the covenant in Genesis 17?
choices: Circumcision of every man child at eight days
questions.explain: It still has to be done; circumcision is one of the laws within the covenant.

questions.q: Through which son is the covenant established?
questions.explain: In Isaac shall thy seed be called; the children of the promise are counted for the seed (Romans 9:7-9).

questions.q: When did Abraham circumcise the males of his house?
choices: The selfsame day he received the commandment
questions.explain: That is the righteous example: he received the commandment and performed it the same day.
